about: The finer B-17's bomber markings (the Battle rules card's "Bomber markings", flyBomberMarks): each part a small mesh in her model file's frame (millimetres, x forward, y right, z up; facings in hundredths), at her near and far levels, drawn over her as an instanced copy. Made by Tools/air_marks/make_b17_marks.py from the model thread's B17Livery.json; never by date.
